.

obscured, faded.

passed away; गतप्राया रजनी.

a widow. {2} (rarely) a woman

--लक्ष्मीक a. {1} bereft

deprived of wealth, impoverished,

.

--शैशव a.

--संग a. {1} free from
attachment. {2} adverse or
indifferent to.

annihilated, lifeless. {2} base.
--सन्नकः an

elephant out of rut.

indifferent to worldly attachments.
